item.title: Murph taps back when it's on it
item.summary: Ask for something that takes a moment, like a reminder, a sleep check, a plan, or a look at a photo, and Murph now reacts to your message with an emoji within about a second so you know it's working. Ask it to change something, like your step goal or a workout in your plan, and you get a thumbs up.
item.details: You get one reaction per run of messages, and none for quick notes, small talk, thanks, or hard news. If you're mid-conversation with Murph, a quick check or a reminder skips the reaction and you just get the answer. When Murph reacts, it skips the separate "working on it" text. In one-on-one iMessage chats.
